headline.purpose: The project name on a project page.

title.purpose: Project names on cards and rows.

body.purpose: Descriptions and panel text, in indigo at 85%.

label.purpose: Panel headings, form labels, menu items, dates, social links.

motion.name: ease-out-strong

motion.purpose: Button, card, dot and arrow changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled indigo button for the main action on a page.

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Flat white card with a silk-coloured edge that sweeps wider on hover.
components.html:
BroadcastHub

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; overflow: hidden; max-width: 520px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(43,47,127,0.3); border-radius: 2px; color: #2b2f7f; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-jost), Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #2b2f7f; } .ds-card:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b23a65; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-card-body { position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.375; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; } .ds-card-text { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(43,47,127,0.85); } .ds-card-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding-top: 8px; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.28em; } .ds-card-link svg { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-link svg { transform: translateX(6px); } .ds-card-silk { position: relative; width: 14%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-card-silk-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #b23a65; transform-origin: right; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-silk-fill { transform: scaleX(1.6); }

components.name: Rail Menu
components.description: Desktop menu: small-caps items with dots on a vertical line.
components.html: HomeWorkContact
components.css: .ds-rail { position: relative; font-family: var(--font-jost), Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-line { position: absolute; top: 20px; bottom: 20px; left: 4.5px; width: 1px; background: rgba(43,47,127,0.3); } .ds-rail-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 14px 0; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.28em; color: #2b2f7f; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rail-dot { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #2b2f7f; background: #f7f6f2; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-rail-item:hover .ds-rail-dot { background: #f2b31a; transform: scale(1.25); } .ds-rail-item[aria-current=page] .ds-rail-dot { background: #2b2f7f; } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b23a65; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Silk Canopy
components.description: Three silk bands with painted crossings over the sky gradient; tops every page header.
components.css: .ds-silk { height: 220px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #dde5f4, #f7f6f2); } .ds-silk svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; transform-origin: 0 0; animation: ds-silk-drift 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } @keyframes ds-silk-drift { from { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) skewY(0deg); } to { transform: translate3d(18px,10px,0) skewY(1.2deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-silk svg { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is a sunlit courtyard. The ground is a warm off-white. Three silk banners (indigo, madder pink, saffron yellow) hang across the top of each page and drift slowly. Real screens of real products sit in the light underneath them. Everything else is quiet: one typeface, one ink colour, thin lines.

Colour does one job. Indigo is the ink for every word, every line and every main control. Madder and saffron are the silk. Where two banners cross, the crossing is painted in an exact third colour, like two dyed cloths laid on top of each other. Away from the canopy, madder and saffron only show up as small signals: a focus ring, a text selection, the edge of a project card.

The layout is a set of ruled panels, not floating cards. Thin indigo lines divide the page into rooms. Type is light and wide: thin capital letters with lots of space between them. The system is light only. It was chosen in place of the dark developer site with a neon accent and a card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white ground, indigo ink, no grey anywhere.
Three silk bands at the top of every page header, with painted crossings.
One typeface (Jost) at weights 300, 400 and 500 only.
Wide-tracked capitals for names, titles, labels and buttons.
Near-square corners (2px) on every control and card.
Soft indigo-tinted shadows only under screenshots and floating things.

rules.name: The Indigo Ink Rule
rules.body: Every word and every line is indigo. Quieter text is indigo at lower opacity (85% for body, never below 75%). There is no grey and no black in this system.

rules.name: The Silk Only Rule
rules.body: Madder and saffron fill large areas only as silk: the canopy bands and the coloured edge of a project card. Anywhere else they are small signals a few pixels wide. They are never a button fill, a panel background or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Painted Chord Rule
rules.body: Where two silk bands cross, paint the crossing in its exact chord colour with a clipped shape. Do not use blend modes. Multiply turns indigo over madder nearly black.

rules.name: The Thin Capitals Rule
rules.body: Display type is weight 300, uppercase and wide-tracked. Nothing in the system is heavier than 500. Only weights 300, 400 and 500 are loaded, so anything bolder would be faked by the browser.

rules.name: The One Label Rule
rules.body: There is one small-caps label style (0.6875rem, 0.28em). Use it for every label. Panel headings are this label on top of a 1px indigo line, set as real headings.

rules.name: The Ruled Panel Rule
rules.body: Sections are separated by a 1px indigo line, never by a gap, a background change or a shadow.

rules.name: The Daylight Shade Rule
rules.body: Shadows are indigo-tinted and only go under screenshots and floating things. Cards, fields and buttons stay flat; they change border or fill on hover, not height.

dos: Do set every word and every line in indigo, and use indigo at 85% for quieter text.
Do open each page with the silk canopy over the sky-to-ground gradient, and leave clear space under it.
Do divide sections with 1px indigo lines at 40% opacity.
Do use the one label style (0.6875rem, uppercase, 0.28em) for every small label.
Do keep controls 48px tall with 2px corners.
Do tint shadows indigo and keep them under screenshots and floating things.
Do give each project card one silk colour, cycling indigo, madder, saffron.
Do show a web screen and a phone screen together when a product has both.
Do stop the silk drift and lean when the visitor asks for reduced motion.
Do use the strong ease-out curve at 200ms for controls and 150ms for colour-only changes.
donts: Don't use grey, black or pure black shadows. The system has no neutral ink.
Don't use madder or saffron as a button fill, a panel background or a heading colour.
Don't use blend modes for silk crossings; paint the chord colour.
Don't use a font weight above 500, or a second typeface.
Don't round corners beyond 2px, except the phone frame, the hero name panel and the rail dots.
Don't put shadows on cards, buttons or fields.
Don't build a dark theme. The world is daylight, and this was the owner's choice.
Don't fill empty screenshot slots with made-up images. Say plainly that the screenshot is to come.
